title: Newly published project graph generations do not reach the text index via incremental reindex
wanted_capability: Published reflective project graph vertices searchable through bbox_hybrid_search after an incremental reindex
missing_primitive: A routine incremental bbox_reindex that ingests newly published project graph generations into the tantivy text index (labels + schema-annotated text properties), without requiring a full reindex or daemon restart
fallback_used: Exact-ref bbox_inspect_entity and scripts/design-graph show work; doc-level discovery still surfaces via the project_file lane.
evidence: session 2026-08-17: design graph on project 89bd722f published and valid (accepted_commit 955c5020, bbox_project_graph_validate ok)
three accepted incremental bbox_reindex passes (~30s apart; first attempt collided with an in-flight edge-index sidecar rebuild)
docs embedding queue drained to depth 0 between probes

bbox_hybrid_search returns zero graph-vertex results for label-exact queries (e.g. Corpus hub) while the vertex indexing machinery exists (crates/bbox-indexing/src/index/graph_docs.rs, graph_vertex_doc in crates/bbox-corpus-index)
notes: RESOLVED-AS-MISDIAGNOSED, same session. Premise was wrong; no substrate defect. Graph word lanes activate on published-view INSTALL (accept-advance via publisher_auto_advance -> refresh_published_graph_views -> converge_published_graph_word_lanes; boot reconcile; capture when no published view is installed), never on incremental bbox_reindex, which by design only PRESERVES existing lanes across its delete-all (reindex.rs collect_graph_lane_documents). The observed absence was the convergence window between pushing the commit and the daemon's accept refresh plus writer-queue settle (minutes; the queue was additionally busy with an edge-index rebuild and a code-route embedding backlog). Confirmed empirically: bbox_project_graph_describe's retrieval block reported indexed_generation == accepted_generation with indexed_vertex_count 3, and hybrid search then surfaced the vertices as project_graph_vertex docs. The diagnostic existed all along and should have been the first probe. Residual idea, not a defect: an operator-triggered reindex could nudge lane convergence for pushed-but-not-yet-accepted graphs as a convenience.
resolution_note: rejected: misdiagnosed per the gap's own investigation notes (RESOLVED-AS-MISDIAGNOSED, same session); graph word lanes activate on published-view install by design, no substrate defect. Closed in operator-approved grounding pass 2026-08-18.
